headers.comment: Blocks this site from ever being embedded in an iframe on another site - the main defense against clickjacking a client into approving a camera prompt they think belongs to a different page. frame-ancestors covers modern browsers; X-Frame-Options is the legacy fallback.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; media-src 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'

headers.comment: Scopes camera access to this exact origin, denies it to any iframe this page might embed, and explicitly denies microphone/geolocation even though nothing here requests them.
